title: RoomObject
description: The room object (contract §4.9): each entry of GET /api/rooms, and the answer of POST /api/rooms/<room>/restore. room.json's fields, each member with its scene object, the number of room layouts and the alignment's status. GET /api/rooms/<room> carries more (room-detail).

name.description: room-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS (UTC of the POST), -2, -3… on collision.

items.title: RoomMemberObject
items.description: A member (room.json) and its scene object (§4.4).

layouts.description: How many room layouts it has (layouts/@<room>/).

align_error.description: The failed align job's sentence, else null.

alignStatus.title: AlignStatus
alignStatus.description: pending while an align job is queued (also while it waits for members to calibrate), running while it runs; else done when align.json exists and the last align job (if any since the server started) succeeded; failed when the last one failed; none when the room was never aligned (no align.json, no job).
